$comment: Single source of truth for Rust crate tiers. Adding a crate to the workspace requires adding it here, so a new dependency wall is a deliberate reviewed act. Enforced by scripts/check/rust-architecture.mjs via `just rust-architecture`.

pure.description: Published library laws. No runtime, transport, framework, or host embedding. Consumed by every other tier.

composition.description: Host-side libraries that embed runtimes and transports. They compose the pure tier and are never depended on by it.

binary.description: Executables that only wire composition crates together. Main function and argument parsing only.

example.description: Executable proofs. Not published, not part of the MSRV promise.
